title: Refreshing Passion Fruit & Raspberry Overnight Oats
description: Porridge oats layered with fat-free Greek yogurt, frozen raspberries and passion fruit pulp, chilled overnight in a jar.
steps: In a glass jar with lid, layer one-third of the oats, then yogurt, then raspberries.
Scoop pulp from half a passion fruit over the raspberries.
Repeat the layering twice more; use the pulp of a whole passion fruit for the final top layer.
notes: Cleaned-out jam jars work great. Use a watertight container for on-the-go. Experiment with different fruits or flavoured yogurts.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
